ارتكسوا (form VIII)
# اِرْتَكَسُوا (irtakasū) /ir.ta.ka.suː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِرْتَكَسَ (irtakasa)
# اُرْتُكِسُوا (urtukisū) /ur.tu.ki.suː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِرْتَكَسَ (irtakasa)
# اِرْتَكِسُوا (irtakisū) /ir.ta.ki.suː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِرْتَكَسَ (irtakasa)
